thread:
Lia (AE): Catalyst POC — customer reports SSE disconnects roughly 40-60s into the stream. Webview shows partial JSON and then parse error. They asked if this is retryable or a pricing cap on our side.
Chris (SalesEng): Can you paste client logs? Is this only on Android webview or iOS too? Any rate-limit responses in the logs?
Lia (AE): Logs from customer attached below (they're reproing on Android webview). No explicit 429s, connection just drops.
Alex (Platform Eng): Paste of client stderr:
```
WARN: sse: connection closed by remote after 44s
ERR: parse failed: unexpected end of input while parsing JSON
RECV: event: {"id":"msg-1","data":"{\"text\": \"Hello\"" 
```
Devon (Infra): Quick diagnostic — looks like the edge proxy is applying gzip to the SSE endpoint and some clients/webviews are closing the socket mid-chunk. When gzip + chunked event streams interact without proper framing we can see partial frames delivered to the client-side parser. Workarounds: disable gzip for /v1/stream or ensure the server emits comment heartbeats.
Marta (QA): Repro'd on our Android webview harness. Adding a heartbeat comment (`:hb\n\n`) every 20s keeps the connection open but doesn't stop partial event framing when a compressed chunk splits an event.
Chris (SalesEng): Customer also asked about dedicated capacity pricing if we recommend moving them off the shared proxy path. I need a quick estimate to share in the next hour. Also they raised security Qs (SAML + EU data residency).
Lia (AE): Noted. For immediate unblock, can eng do an SDK change so the client buffers until it sees a full SSE event delimiter (\n\n) before attempting JSON.parse? That would make older webviews tolerant to partial chunks.
Alex (Platform Eng): I can implement a small change in the JS/Android SDK stream parser to accumulate chunk fragments until the trailing blank line. Will add telemetry counter `sse.partial_frame_count`. Can ship a canary in ~24h.
Devon (Infra): If we want an infra fix: I can add a proxy rule to disable gzip on /v1/stream and set `Cache-Control: no-transform` for event streams. That requires a quick router reload (5m rolling change). I'll schedule only if SDK patch doesn't reduce incidents.
Marta (QA): We'll run the Android harness against Alex's branch once it's up. If the SDK patch works, we can avoid immediate infra risk.
Chris (SalesEng): I'll compute a dedicated capacity ballpark and include the security checklist status in the customer update.
Lia (AE): Plan: 1) push SDK buffering patch canary; 2) QA run; 3) if still flaky, infra gzip rule; 4) escalate pricing/security details in the account call. I'll update the customer now and book follow-up. :thumbsup: 
QA-bot: Synthetic test "streams/catalyst" failed at 14:03 (timeout). Re-ran at 14:06 and passed.
Alex (Platform Eng): FYI I've created a PR and linked the telemetry dashboard. Will post the canary link when available.
Lia (AE): Thanks all — I'll close the loop with the customer and add the security questionnaire owners to the thread.
__notes: This thread captures a sales POC swarm: SSE disconnects, partial chunks, client parsing errors, proposed SDK and infra mitigations, pricing and security blockers.
